title: GTA 6: What Rockstar Has Actually Confirmed

segments.headline: THE DATE IS OFFICIAL
segments.text: Here is what Rockstar has actually confirmed about Grand Theft Auto Six, without the rumor mill. GTA Six is scheduled to launch on November nineteenth, twenty twenty-six, for PlayStation Five and Xbox Series X and S. Pre-orders are already open. Rockstar has also released an extended look at the game, so we finally have a much clearer picture of what this version of Vice City is supposed to be.

segments.headline: THIS WAS REAL GAME FOOTAGE
segments.text: The biggest detail from Rockstar's extended look is simple: the footage was captured entirely from in-game footage on PlayStation Five. Rockstar describes GTA Six as the biggest and most immersive evolution of the series yet. That matters because these are not just cinematic promises. Rockstar is showing us the world, characters, vehicles, locations, and atmosphere through footage coming directly from the game.

segments.headline: JASON + LUCIA ARE THE CENTER
segments.text: Jason and Lucia are still the center of the story. Rockstar says an easy score goes wrong and pulls them into a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida. The official description makes one thing clear: their relationship is not just background flavor. They are forced to rely on each other to survive, which means the partnership itself looks like a major part of the story structure.

segments.headline: PRELOAD STARTS NOVEMBER 12
segments.text: Rockstar has also confirmed the launch logistics. Digital pre-orders can begin pre-loading on November twelfth, one week before release. The physical version is also scheduled to be available starting November twelfth and contains a download code to support pre-loading. Purchases made before November twentieth include the Vintage Vice City Pack, a bonus built around classic Vice City nostalgia.

segments.headline: WHAT ROCKSTAR HAS NOT CONFIRMED
segments.text: And here is the part people keep skipping. Rockstar's official launch information currently names PlayStation Five and Xbox Series X and S. It does not give a PC release date on the official GTA Six page. So whenever you see a specific PC date, online-mode launch date, map size number, or feature list floating around, check whether Rockstar actually said it. The Six Report is separating confirmed GTA news from internet guesses every day.
